checkpoint.compiled_tree_sha256_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(implementation_initial.files,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)); ordered path/SHA256 records for every file under dist, including declarations/maps.
checkpoint.scope_note: Coordinator supplied coherent compiled checkpoint. Later source/build changes are not evaluated by this run.

observed_gaps.explanation: Missing/unrecovered functions and resource-limit failures remain failures. Returning source text, complete labels or nontruncation do not prove source-equivalent behavior.

baseline.excluded: Project databases; duplicate stdout/wire streams; per-tool run.json duplicates (complete run objects are retained in comparison.json). Numbered raw requests/responses, tool schemas, calls, invocations, all C and complete assembled artifacts retained unchanged.

limitations: One serialized static-analysis observation per cell, no repeated-run performance claim.
Source and build-time function addresses known; no independent behavioral equivalence validation.
Only zlib checksum/combine routines, not all compression or arbitrary real-world programs.
Both compiler variants share Clang lineage; independently built Apple21 and upstream LLVM23, not independent front-end algorithms.
Source-known analysis corpus only, not independent behavioral correctness or blind readability evaluation.
Source-only functional smokes may have run concurrently; observed wall times are not performance evidence.
Ghidra bridge missing-function failures describe this exact import/discovery/MCP configuration; not a universal Ghidra engine coverage claim.
checks_not_run: Repository build/typecheck/tests/lint/format by harness agent; integration build supplied by coordinator.
Raised-budget reruns, retries, pass tuning, heldout decompilation and performance distributions.
